The momentum of a body is changed by a force acting on it for a period of time.
Which action increases the change in momentum?
A
doubling the force and halving the time
B
doubling the force for the same time
C
halving both the force and the time
D
halving the force and doubling the time

options.label: A
options.text: doubling the force and halving the time

options.label: B
options.text: doubling the force for the same time

options.label: C
options.text: halving both the force and the time

options.label: D
options.text: halving the force and doubling the time
